title: Design System: WMKF Document Processing Suite

display.purpose: Suite landing title and rare page-level moments.

headline.purpose: Major page or section headings with room to breathe.

title.purpose: Request titles, card titles, and primary panel headings.

body.purpose: Reading copy and normal control content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for an operational choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111827; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f2937; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #6b7280; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A clear alternative that stays subordinate to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f3f4f6; color: #111827; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e5e7eb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #d1d5db; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet supporting action on white or neutral surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #374151; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f9fafb; border-color: #9ca3af; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #d1d5db; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Reserved for destructive or critical actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #dc2626; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #ef4444; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A bordered working surface with a shallow resting shadow.
components.html:
Request overview

Current information and the next available action.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #111827; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #d1d5db; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 28px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #4b5563; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A white field with a clear boundary and explicit focus state.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #374151; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: #111827; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 16px/24px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Confirmed Status Chip
components.description: A compact state label pairing semantic color with explicit text.
components.css: .ds-chip-confirmed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f0fdf4; color: #15803d; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 12px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Workbench Tab
components.description: An overflow-safe task tab with a restrained active marker.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: #6b7280; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #374151; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b7280; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-active { color: #111827; border-bottom-color: #111827; }

components.name: Overlay Dialog
components.description: A clearly elevated transient layer for consequential choices.
components.html:
Confirm action

Review the effect before continuing.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(100%, 32rem); background: #fff; color: #111827; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 28px; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; color: #4b5563; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
The suite should feel like a well-prepared working surface: calm, precise, and trustworthy, with the record, the evidence, and the next action easy to locate. It is an internal operational environment rather than a consumer product, so clarity and confidence outrank visual novelty, marketing gloss, or theatrical effects.

The incumbent system is quietly tactile and decisive. Neutral surfaces and fine borders organize dense grant work; restrained elevation marks interaction and overlays; dark primary actions make commitments unambiguous. Color appears when it conveys action, status, or risk, not as decoration.
keyCharacteristics: White working surfaces on a cool gray canvas.
Dark, decisive primary actions with explicit secondary choices.
Semantic color used sparingly and consistently.
Rounded, lightly layered components with brief feedback.

rules.name: The Meaningful Color Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces carry structure. Blue is for action, green for confirmed success, amber for attention, red for danger or failure, and violet only where an analytical/review distinction already exists.

rules.name: The Scan-First Type Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and spacing—not decorative font changes.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal contrast to establish structure; increase shadow only for interaction or true overlay depth.

dos: Do use Foundation Ink for the primary operational action and active state.
Do let white surfaces, gray borders, and spacing carry most structural hierarchy.
Do reserve semantic color for action, status, risk, and established analytical meaning.
Do use 0.5rem controls, 0.75rem cards, and full rounding for compact status.
Do keep state feedback brief, explicit, and paired with text or iconography.
donts: Don't turn the configured blue, green, and violet ramps into competing brand fields.
Don't elevate every container; use stronger shadows only for interaction and overlays.
Don't introduce consumer-SaaS gloss, theatrical effects, or decorative branding into operational surfaces.
Don't introduce a suite-wide logo treatment without a new explicit brand decision.
Don't communicate consequential state through color alone.
